                     TECHNICAL
            POLICY AND PROCEDURE NOTICE #5/87


TO:         BOROUGH SUPERINTENDENTS

FROM:       GEORGE E. BERGER, P.E.
            Assistant Commissioner

DATE:       July 9, 1987

SUBJECT:    Application for Non-Water Fire Suppression Systems
               (Halon, Ansul, Etc.)



Based upon meetings of Buildings Department and Fire Depart-
ment,present acceptance procedure of Directive 14 of 1975
(modification #4, 3/20/80), and the need for compliance with
Fire Department Directive 3 of 1974, all applications for
Halon, Ansul, or any a other non-water Fire Suppression System
will be forwarded to the Fire Department for examination
and approval. Such systems shall be filed as Miscellaneous
applications.

As is the case with Miscallaneous applications for Fire
Alarm Systems, the applicant shall be responsible for trans-
mitting a complete copy of the application to the Fire Depart-
ment. After Fire Department approval of the application,
Department of Buildings shall accept under Directive 14/75
with no further examination. Upon completion of the work,
the applicant, owner or a representative of either shall
arrange for an inspection by the Fire Department. When the
Fire Department notifies the Borough Superintendent by
letter that the system is complete and satisfactory, the
Department of Buildings shall sign off the application and
issue a letter of completion.

This procedure shall take effect immediately.                                 ,m1
